title: Bin Space and the Quantity a Storage Period Is Charged On
content:
Which bushels the period is billed on follows the space the programme ties up. This rule governs Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements, and it turns on whether the programme keeps the lot out of the house bin and on how the bushels on hand stand against the space the agreement reserves.

## The provision

Where the programme keeps the lot out of the house bin and the bushels on hand stand below the space the agreement reserves, the period is billed on the space the agreement reserves, because that space is held for the member and let to nobody else. Where the programme keeps the lot out of the house bin and the bushels on hand stand at or above the space reserved, the period is billed on the bushels on hand. And where the programme commingles the lot with the house bin, the period is billed on the bushels free to move.

The bushels on hand are backed out of the storage account, being the bushels taken into store under the agreement less the bushels taken off for shrink and less the bushels loaded out. The bushels free to move are those bushels less the bushels pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt.

## The two particulars the clause reads

| Programme | Lot may be commingled with the house bin | Space the agreement reserves (bu) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | yes | 0 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | yes | 0 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes | 0 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes | 0 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes | 25000 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | no | 60000 |

## Condition, judgement, result

| The programme | The bushels on hand | The period is billed on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| keeps the lot out of the house bin | stand below the space the agreement reserves | the space the agreement reserves |
| keeps the lot out of the house bin | stand at or above the space reserved | the bushels on hand |
| commingles the lot with the house bin | whatever they stand at | the bushels free to move |

## Boundary illustration, on hypothetical figures

An agreement on the one programme that keeps the lot out of the house bin reserves 60000 bushels. Standing at 47500 bushels on hand, which is below that space, the period is billed on 60000. Standing at exactly 60000 bushels on hand, which is at the space reserved rather than below it, the period is billed on the 60000 bushels on hand. Standing at 72000, which is above it, the period is billed on the 72000 bushels on hand.

On a programme that commingles the lot, an agreement showing 30000 bushels taken in, 250 taken off for shrink and 4000 loaded out has 25750 bushels on hand; with 2000 bushels pledged against an outstanding receipt, the period is billed on 23750 bushels free to move.
